title: Explaining Preference Heterogeneity with Mixed Membership Modeling
authors: Marc R. Dotson; Joachim Büschken; Greg M. Allenby
eligible_reason: Hierarchical multinomial logit conjoint models with grade-of-membership covariate models (robotic vacuums, smartphones surveys). Cross-sectional choice data, no DiD.
design_notes: Scripts 00-04 run a simulation experiment and the binary-covariates, membership-vector, factor-scores and constrained-membership models; fit via hold-out hit rates.
data_files_note: Conjoint choice and survey covariate data for both applications.
data_provenance_note: Survey/conjoint data as used in the paper; no masking stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
